newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NCA fuel surcharge from Netherlands likely soon.
newsitem.headline: NCA fuel surcharge from Netherlands likely soon.

text.p: Nippon Cargo Airline, the Japanese all-cargo ailrine, is likely to implement a fuel surcharge from the Netherlands shortly, said Gino Laan, a marketing executive with the airline based in Amsterdam.
NCA has already introduced a fuel surcharge in Germany, he added, following Germany's national carrier, Lufthansa.
"We usually follow the national carrier but it depends on the local market conditions," he added. A 15 pfennig per kilo rise has been introduced in Germany.
"In Japanese yen terms we have seen a 32 percent increase in fuel costs over the past few months," said Laan.
The Japanese carrier is studying the situation in the Netherlands and NCA would probably follow the example set by KLM, he said.
Dutch national carrier, KLM, introduced a 20 guilder cents surcharge from November 1.
NCA would drop any surcharge once the situation improves but at the moment we are faced with high buying prices, he said. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542-7706 Fax+44 171 542-5017
